text: Hello boys and girls, welcome to our English class.My name is Wudan.Nice to meet you again.Where have you been in the city you live with your family and relatives?Did you take some photos when you went there?In this lesson, you are going to write about some photos.Before we start our lesson, please make sure you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook,worksheet and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单,和笔。Shall we begin?Look at the photo.If you want to know more about it,what questions will you ask Kitty?Where have you been?Who is with you in the photo?What are you doing together?Good.Think it over.What can you learn from a photo?We can know about the place he or she has been to.The persons in the photo.And the activity they are doing in the photo.Look at this word, activity.There are two eyes in this word.Do you know how to read it?Now please read after the recording.Activity.Again.Suppose you are Kitty.Make a dialogue with your classmate.Talk about the photo with the help of the keywords, like this.Are you ready?Come on.Lisa and Mary are my students.Let's read the dialogue between them.We can have a lot of interesting activities with our family members.We can have a lot of interesting activities with our family members and relatives in our spare time.Now, please take out your worksheet.Look at task one.Look at the pictures.Complete the sentences with the phrases given.Time is up.Let's check.Look at the first picture.My family and I are having a barbecue.Can you tell the meaning of barbecue?Yes, it means 烧烤.Please read after the recording.Barbecue.Look at picture two.My cousins and I are collecting shells.They are picking up the shells and putting them in baskets.What is the meaning of collect?It means 收集.Collect.Look at picture three.There is a kite in the picture.Look, here it is.Kite means 风筝.Kite.Kite is a countable noun.We can say 飞机.In the picture, my parents and I are flying a kite.Look at the last picture.The kids are at the beach.The new word sandcastle is made up of the word sand and the word castle.Sand means 沙子.Castle means 城堡.Can you tell the meaning of sandcastle?Yes, it means 沙堡.Sandcastle.Sandcastle is a countable noun.We can say 沙堡.In the picture, my sister and I are making a sandcastle.Did you get all the answers right?Look at the picture.It is an album.We put our photos together in an album.What is the meaning of album?It means 照片部.Album.Think about the questions.Why do you make a family album?What kind of photos will you collect in your family album?I usually make a family album to collect memories with my family and relatives.I will choose photos taken in different places with different family members or relatives, so that I can collect as many memories as possible.Look at task 2.Write about this photo.When you are writing, what do you need to do?Yes, you should use I have been to to show the place you have been to.Anything else?You should use a photo of to show who are in the photo.You should use the present continuous tense to describe what you are doing in the photo.You will have one minute to finish the writing.Ready?StartTom is my student.Let's take a look at his writing.I have been to see Saitang on Lucky Island with my brother.This is a photo of my brother and me.We are cycling together.He used I have been to and a photo of.He used the present continuous tense to describe what he was doing in the photo.I think Tom did a good job.Look at task 3 on your worksheet.Write about the photo with the help of the keywords below.StartYou should use the present continuous tense to describe what he was doing in the photo.You should use the present continuous tense to describe what he was doing in the photo.I have been to Huaihai Road in Shanghai with my mother.I like Huaihai Road because there are a lot of shops there.This is a photo of my mother and me.We are shopping together.It's always interesting to go out with my mother.She used I have been to and a photo of.She used the present continuous tense to describe the activity in the photo.She wrote I like Huaihai Road because there are a lot of shops there.She wrote about the place she has been to.She wrote it's always interesting to go out with my mother.She also wrote about her feeling.Well done Lucy.Look at these four photos.Suppose you are Tom.Write about each photo.When you are writing, remember to write about the places and the persons in the photos.Write about the activities in the photos and use the tenses correctly.You may also write about your feelings.You will have two minutes to finish your writing.StartYou may also write about your feelings.StartLet's read my student Ben's writing.Photo one.I have been to Ocean Park in Shanghai with my family.We usually go there by bus.You can watch fish and other sea animals there.This is a photo of my sister and me.We are watching a dolphin show.I really like this place.Photo two.I have been to the beach in Shanghai with my mother.It's far away from my home.The beach is clean and you can find many beautiful shells there.I am collecting shells.He wrote about what he thought of the places.Well done.Photo three.I have been to Country Park in Shanghai with my family.It's a quiet and beautiful park.It's near my home.I usually go there on foot.This is a photo of my family and me.We are having a picnic together.Photo four.I have been to Changfeng Park with my cousins.We usually go there on foot at weekends.This is a photo of my cousins and me.We are having a barbecue together.I love having barbecues.It is fun.She wrote about what he thought of Country Park.He also wrote about what he thought of having a barbecue.Good job.What do you think of the album?Ben wrote about the places and the persons in the photos.He wrote about the activities in the photos.He used the tenses correctly.He also wrote about his feelings.I think Ben has done an excellent job.What about your writing?Maybe yours is better.Let's sum up.In this lesson,you have learned the new words activity,collect,album and sandcastle.You have learned how to write about photos of you and your family or relatives in different places.You have also learned how to make a family album.It's always pleasant to go out with our family and relatives.Making an album can help us collect all those happy memories.Why not make a family album right now?After class,please finish the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.
